name: One Click
source:
Meet Renee, a young, successful phlebotomist working at a prestigious hospital. By all accounts, she’s won at life - yet something’s missing. Faced with her life's monotony, she moves to New York, aspiring to become the next best selling author. 

Join Renee in the new chapter of her life as she ascends the creative ladder, meets a warm and friendly team, and navigates the new world of game development. After all, something more is behind every single choice.

[From [url=https://caramac.itch.io/one-click]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
来认识一下蕾妮，她是一位年轻、成功的抽血医生，在一家著名的医院工作。从各方面来看，她已经赢得了人生——但仍然缺少一些东西。面对单调的生活，她搬到了纽约，立志成为下一个畅销书作家。

与Renee一起开启她人生的新篇章，她攀登创意阶梯，结识热情友好的团队，并探索游戏开发的新世界。毕竟，每一个选择背后都有更多的东西。

[来自[url=https://caramac.itch.io/one-click]itch.io[/url]]
